name: The Forge of Fury
summary: Khundrukar, the lost stronghold of the smith Durgeddin the Black. Four descending dungeon levels — the Mountain Door, the Glitterhame, the Foundry, and the Black Lake — culminating in the young black dragon Nightscale. Built for a 6-PC party (encounters pre-scaled +50%).

items.name: Nightfang (+2 short sword, Durgeddin masterwork — extra damage vs orcs/goblinoids)
Dwarven Plate (heavy armor, +2 AC over plate)

random_encounters.note: Travel/exploration loop: roll d12 when the party lingers or makes noise; on 9+ run a wandering encounter drawn from this table. ALL enemies reference monsters/ here — never invent (anti-drift). Scale counts +50% for the 6-PC party.

table.desc: a rat swarm from the deep tunnels
stirges roused from a side cavern
a troglodyte patrol from the Glitterhame
